meaningKo: 소중한 시간을 잘 활용하다, 의미 있게 만들다
exampleEn: You only have one shot at this, so make it count.
exampleKo: 너는 이 기회가 한 번뿐이니, 잘 활용해.
gameExamples: Every moment spent with loved ones is precious, so make it count.
In life, you have to take risks and make it count when you have the chance.
As you prepare for the big game, remember to stay focused and make it count.
